
A single Go projector (`internal/projector`) reads the backbone's state log, finds the projects dirtied since its checkpoint, and writes quads to `graph-server` over the Graph Store Protocol on the fixed `main` branch, authenticating with Keycloak client credentials (`LODE_GRAPHSERVER_CLIENT_ID`, e.g. `dataplatform-svc`). `graph-server` exposes no SPARQL Update, so the projector re-renders every task of a dirty project and replaces that project's named graph wholesale with `PUT`. Rendering is deterministic, so an unchanged re-projection is byte-identical and idempotent. A project that fails to write is quarantined and retried on its own backoff while the checkpoint advances past the others; `GET /api/v1/graph/projection/failures` and `lode graph quarantines` list the quarantine.
